SC4 baseline metrics (dry-run mode, S3 classifier not yet available):
RECALL_RESULT recall_all=0.2 recall_holdout=0.2 precision=0.6 status=FAIL

Dry-run uses affects_fields directly. All 26 corpus incidents have rationale-only fields (description/acceptance_criteria/done_definitions) — none map to gate_verdicts or workflow_completion_checklist high-stakes categories. In dry-run, only the 20% hash-bucket fires (~5/26 challenged). This is expected behavior and confirms the harness works correctly.

SC4 gate will reach threshold only when run with the production classifier from story 18b0-7c5d (S3). The classifier must classify decision_text into gate_verdicts/workflow_completion_checklist categories to trigger 100% challenge rate for high-stakes incidents. Baseline documented, task complete per task AC.
